scores.evidence: Each of the 3 can-do objectives has 2 or more graded questions, and each set includes an apply-level item or higher (o1: q4, e1, e2; o2: q2, q3, e3; o3: q5, e6). But o1 lists 「CLAUDE.md・.claude/rules/・CLAUDE.local.md・権限ルール」, while its two exam items test a hook (e2, answer 「フックで自動的に実行させる」) and AGENTS.md loading (e1). Neither of those is among the places o1 names.

hook-b1 sets a concrete problem in 3 sentences (the repeated 「テストは `npm run test:unit` で」, and a 300-line CLAUDE.md with 「`.env` は絶対に読まない」). hook-predict q0 asks an ungraded prediction tied to o3, with no overclaim now (「Claudeの判断に関係なく止められるのはどれ」). The lead promises 「何を、どこに、どれだけ書けばよいのか、まず予想してみましょう」, but the prediction covers only how to block `.env`.

Prerequisites list 第1回–第5回, and the lesson recalls them where they are needed (「第1回と第5回で見たとおり」 in s1-lead, 「第2回で書いた、ツールの使用を…」 in s4-defs, 第2回 in s4-close). New terms are defined before use (s1-defs, s3-defs, s4-defs). The glossary's AGENTS.md entry now gives the same condition as s3-defs and card-agents (「CLAUDE.md・`.claude/CLAUDE.md`・CLAUDE.local.mdのどれもないときに読まれます。これは既定の動きです」).

measure.mjs: 「prose 2398 (budget 1,200–2,400) · questions 9 · est 19.0 min (must be ≤ 20; estMinutes 19)」, so the lesson is within budget and estMinutes matches. Lint --strict reports 0 warnings. But prose is 2 characters under the cap. s3 still holds imports, path-scoped rules, AGENTS.md, a code block, a diagram and a version callout in one segment.

s5-steps is a complete worked example before practice: 6 subgoal-labelled steps (「① コードからわかる行を消す」…「⑥ 自分だけの好みをローカルへ移す」), each with a reason in md and a result in expect (「チームのCLAUDE.mdは2行になります」). No faded example sits between it and the independent 18-line practice.

s1–s4 each end with an inline check that gives feedback on every wrong option. q2 is now a repair item, and q4 asks where a new 10-line rule set belongs. Two items are still partly answerable by recognition: q2's answer is the only option that repeats s1-concat's phrase 「矛盾する2行」, and q5's answer 「判断の材料として読まれ、強制はされない」 restates s4-lead 「参考に判断しますが、必ず守るという保証はありません」.

Every misconception in the brief appears as a distractor, with feedback of 2 sentences or fewer: override vs concatenation (q2 b, e1 a), `@` reducing context (q4 c, e3 a), longer is better or the 200-line limit as a guarantee (q5 b, e6 b), auto mode (e6 d). The deny overclaim is gone. But the 「IMPORTANT」 option is the wrong answer in five items (q0 a, q2 a, q5 a, e3 c, e6 a), so learners can eliminate it by pattern. The 「前の会話を覚えている」 misconception appears only once (q0 c).

s3-diagram has 8 nodes with labels that match the text (「paths: 付きのルール」, 「自動メモリの先頭」). Its caption states the takeaway (「インポートしても、毎回読まれる量は減りません。減らせるのは paths: 付きのルールです。」) and the alt text is full. s1-table, s2-table and s4-table are real comparisons, and there are no decorative images.

The task is authentic and calls for transfer: the learner sorts 18 lines before prompting, including cases the example did not show (git push, the 「毎回必ず」 format line → 「後でフックにする」). It has a 3-level hint ladder (pr-decide hint → troubleshoot → practice-hint3), a 7-item checklist, a model answer (practice-answer, practice-answer-settings) and a check with /context and /permissions. practice-hint3 now matches s4-table on line 9 (「9行目の「毎回必ず」はフックの候補（第8回）」).

summary-points (4 points) comes after the exam. summary-next asks a reflection question (「ここ1週間で、Claudeに2回以上した同じ説明や直しはありますか」) and names the next step (第7回). summary-cards has 7 cards, and summary-ask offers tutor prompts.

Every audit finding marked confirmed is fixed in the text: s3-defs AGENTS.md matches the checker's betterFix, card-agents adds 「既定では」, the glossary adds 「これは既定の動きです」, and the q4 explanation and card-paths now say 「1つのファイルを `cat` や `head` で見たとき」. s4-close states the limit of deny rules (「`git -C . push` のような別の書き方は止まりません」), which matches cc-02. Versions are pinned (v2.1.304, v2.1.277). Small precision gaps remain: the glossary AGENTS.md entry leaves out 「作業フォルダーとその上」 and the fact that ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md does not count, and pr-permissions expects exact rule strings that Claude may write differently.

The text is consistent です・ます, warm and free of pressure (「まず予想してみましょう」, 「迷ったら…確かめましょう」, 「大事なリポジトリでは試さないでください」). Lint finds no banned phrases or long sentences, and katakana terms carry the English on first use (「インポート（import）」, 「分類器（classifier）」). Wording is left to ja-editor.
The only declared locale is jp, and it is complete. s3-diagram has caption and alt, the link text says where it goes (「公式ドキュメント（日本語）」 in s3-info), and no text is baked into images.

niceToHave: Budget guard: measure.mjs reports prose 2398 of the 2,400 cap. Offset any text added by the items below with an equal cut, e.g. drop s3-lead's second sentence 「ただし、分け方で読み込まれるタイミングが変わります。」 (the s3-diagram caption already makes that point).
hook-b1: so the promise matches the single predict question, replace 「何を、どこに、どれだけ書けばよいのか、まず予想してみましょう。」 with 「まず、`.env` の読み取りをどう止めるか、予想してみましょう。」
s1-check q2 option c: replace 「矛盾する2行の片方を消して、どちらか1つにそろえる」 with 「どちらか片方の行を消して、1つにそろえる」. That removes the only option that repeats s1-concat's 「矛盾する2行」.

check-quiz e6 option a: 「IMPORTANT」 is the wrong answer in five items. Replace it with md 「「前のセッションで頼んであるから、もう覚えているよ」」 and feedback 「セッションは毎回まっさらに始まり、前の会話は引き継がれません。止めたい操作は、拒否ルールやフックで決めておきます。」 This tests the brief's 「前回の会話を覚えている」 misconception.

check-quiz e2: the item repeats s4-table row 2 and practice line 9, so it is recall rather than transfer. Option: change the prompt to 「Claudeが返事を終えるたびに、必ず通知音を鳴らしたいとき、どうしますか？」 and option a's feedback to 「Claudeが音を鳴らすと決めるのと、音が自動で鳴るのは別のことです。毎回必ず起こすならフックです。」 Keep options b, c and d as they are.
check-quiz e3 option a feedback: the file does get shorter, only the load does not. Replace 「整理にはなっても、短くはなりません。」 with 「整理にはなっても、毎回読まれる量はそのままです。」
practice-hint3: the hint says 「7・8行目はテストのコマンドの行にまとめます」, but practice-answer keeps two test lines. Replace that clause with 「7行目は「コミットの前に `npm run test:unit` を通す」に直し、8行目は残します」.
practice-steps pr-permissions expect: Claude may write `Bash(git push:*)` or `Read(.env)`. Replace it with 「拒否ルールとして、`.env` の読み取りと `git push` を止める2行が見つかります（例：`Read(./.env)`、`Bash(git push *)`）。」
practice-steps pr-context expect: add 「自動メモリがあれば、それも表示されます。」 so a learner with an existing MEMORY.md is not confused by the extra entry.
objectives.o1: e2 assesses a hook under o1. Consider 「指示の置き場所（CLAUDE.md・.claude/rules/・CLAUDE.local.md・権限ルール・フック）を、内容に合わせて選べる」. Changing an objective makes the next round a full review.
glossary AGENTS.md: align it with s3-defs: 「ほかのAIコーディングツールと共有する指示のファイル。既定では、作業フォルダーとその上にCLAUDE.mdもCLAUDE.local.mdもないときに読まれます。`~/.claude/CLAUDE.md` は数えません（v2.1.277以降）。」
summary: The scope check required a full review: objectives.o1 changed, and 37% of the lesson's parts (56% of its blocks) changed. All 9 must-fix items from round 1 are gone: the deny overclaim (q0, q5, card-never, s4-close limit), the glossary AGENTS.md condition, q2 rewritten as a repair item, the line-9 hint, and estMinutes (measure.mjs: est 19.0, estMinutes 19). The audit's confirmed findings are also applied. The biggest strength is the worked example followed by a transfer practice with a full hint ladder, a checklist and a model answer. The most useful next fix is to vary the distractors: 「IMPORTANT」 is the wrong option in five items. Keep within the 2,400-character prose cap while doing so.
